baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative construction joins the causative-denial verb to temporal afterness and to dīn.
baseline_models.mechanism: Declaring a claim false, followed by an explicit temporal threshold and the reckoning branch of dīn, makes the question search for any remaining ground capable of producing denial.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a person or claim false supplies the denial whose possible cause the interrogative tests.
Afterness supplies a threshold already crossed, making any subsequent denial answerable to what preceded it.
Reckoning and recompense identify the proposition being treated as false.

changed_reading.before: A bare question asks why the addressee denies religion.
changed_reading.after: The line is an evidentiary challenge: after a threshold has been reached, what possible ground remains for treating reckoning and recompense as false?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object suffix on the denial verb permits attention to the addressee as the one who may be declared false, while dīn can concern crediting someone in judgment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The false-attribution branch and the judicial-credit branch reverse the usual direction of agency: the question can ask what could discredit the addressee concerning the account, not only what makes the addressee deny it.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood to a person makes the addressee a possible object of discrediting.
Afterness marks the point beyond which an impeachment of credibility would need new force.
Crediting a person in judgment supplies a forensic setting for testing the addressee's truthfulness.

changed_reading.before: The addressee is simply the agent who denies.
changed_reading.after: The addressee may also be the one whose credibility is challenged: what, after this, could still impeach you in the matter submitted to judgment?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The denial root carries branches of obligation and of a charge proving true or false by whether it is carried through.
baseline_models.mechanism: Obligation supplies a commission, performance makes that commission true or false in action, and dīn as obedience supplies its governing relation. Denial thus becomes enacted failure rather than only a false proposition.

activation_trace.role: The formula of urging or incumbency supplies a charge laid upon the addressee.
A charge proving true only when carried through turns truth into performed fidelity.
Afterness locates the performance test beyond a prior commissioning point.
Obedience and submission identify the relation in which the charge must be carried through.

changed_reading.before: Denial is an inward opinion or spoken claim.
changed_reading.after: The question can probe enacted falsification: what makes you fail to carry an incumbent charge through after it has been laid upon you?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Temporal afterness stands directly beside a dīn branch of debt and credit.
baseline_models.mechanism: The packet supplies laterness and a financial due; taking laterness as the maturity of that due is the model's abductive link. The denial verb then becomes repudiation of an obligation once it comes due.

activation_trace.role: Denying or disproving supplies the act of disputing a claim made upon the addressee.
Laterness supplies the interval between incurring a due and its maturity.
Debt and credit turn dīn into an outstanding due rather than an abstract label.

changed_reading.after: Dīn can be heard as a deferred due: what makes you dispute the claim after the time for settlement has arrived?

context_deltas.mechanism: Edible fruit and extracted oil establish a material yield. Beside the focus branch in which milk disappoints by not lasting, that yield activates an analogy: why should recompense be imagined as the one return that fails after its productive process?

activation_trace.role: A milk yield that disappears or fails expectation supplies the concrete shape of an expected return proving false.
Afterness supplies the delay between a productive process and its yield.
Recompense supplies the moral yield whose expected arrival is being tested.
The edible fruit supplies a produced good that comes to ripeness and use.
Oil as extracted olive yield supplies a second transformation whose result is materially realized.

structural_cues: The opening pair places an edible fruit beside an oil-bearing product before the focus question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fruit, oil, and a focus image of a yield failing to last; I supply the arrow from dependable material yield to dependable recompense. The pair may instead function only as oath objects or places, so this remains exploratory.

changed_reading.before: The question asks abstractly why reckoning is denied.
changed_reading.after: The question can challenge a failed-yield expectation: after witnessing processes that bear fruit and oil, why imagine that accountable action alone bears no lasting return?

context_deltas.mechanism: The mountain root opens both a limit and successive phases. Those images thicken temporal afterness into a crossed boundary in a staged trajectory, with reckoning as what lies beyond the phase rather than as an unrelated doctrine.

activation_trace.role: Afterness supplies movement from a prior phase into what follows.
Reckoning supplies the accountable destination beyond the threshold.
A limit at which one stops or crosses gives afterness the geometry of a threshold.
Successive states supply a phased process through which the addressee moves.

structural_cues: A named mountain precedes a sequence about human formation and reversal, allowing its boundary and phase branches to organize that sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies boundary, stage, afterness, and reckoning; I infer that the phases lead toward an accountable threshold. A purely locative mountain reading remains live and would weaken this trajectory.

changed_reading.before: After is only a discourse marker meaning after what was just said.
changed_reading.after: After becomes a phase boundary: having crossed a staged course toward accountability, what could still make the destination seem false?

context_deltas.mechanism: A bounded polity qualified by security and trust activates dīn as a city of ordered authority and as judicial credit. Denial now resembles a breach of the trust and accountable ordering that make shared security possible.

activation_trace.role: Declaring false supplies both repudiation of the order and damage to credibility within it.
A city constituted by ordered authority connects dīn directly to civic organization.
Crediting someone in judgment supplies the trust procedure within the ordered city.
A delimited tract of land supplies the bounded civic space in which order operates.
Security and settled trust supply the social condition produced or protected by accountable order.
Heart-settling credit supplies the opposite relational posture to declaring the order false.

structural_cues: The place noun and its trust-bearing adjective form one compact civic unit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded place, security, trust, ordered authority, and judicial credit; I infer that acknowledged accountability helps sustain civic security. The adjective can remain a simple epithet, so the causal civic claim is not forced.

changed_reading.before: Dīn is a private belief that an individual may deny.
changed_reading.after: Dīn can name a trust-bearing public order: what could make you repudiate the accountability by which a secure polity credits persons and maintains order?

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured creation, perceptible humanity, goodness, and upright balance assemble an embodied exhibit. The otherwise unspecified afterness now points back to accessible design evidence, making denial of reckoning answerable to the measured capacity already displayed.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the account false supplies the conclusion placed under evidentiary pressure.
Afterness points to the completed presentation of embodied evidence.
Reckoning is the future claim tested against the demonstrated measure.
Measuring and proportioning supply deliberate calibration rather than accidental appearance.
Perceiving by sight, sense, or hearing makes the human exhibit epistemically available.
Goodness opposed to ugliness supplies a qualitative appraisal of the formed human.
Uprightness, balance, and evenness supply the configuration in which the measure is realized.
Equal weight and proportion reinforce the image of an assessed, balanced construction.

structural_cues: A first-person-plural act of creation is followed by a human object and a superlative measure phrase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calibrated creation, perceptibility, goodness, balance, and later reckoning; I infer that demonstrated formative capacity is evidence for accountable remeasurement. The description may concern present form alone and need not by itself entail future judgment.

changed_reading.before: The prior basis indicated by after remains unspecified.
changed_reading.after: After points to the addressee's own measured embodiment: what could make reckoning incredible after the responsible power to proportion human life has already been exhibited?

context_deltas.mechanism: A complete upright form is followed by return into a lower place or rank. With falsehood in action and a charge failing when not carried through, the focus can ask what makes a human trajectory belie its own bestowed configuration.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood in action allows denial to be embodied in a lived trajectory rather than confined to speech.
A charge that proves false by not being carried through supplies the performance failure.
Reckoning evaluates whether the endowed trajectory was carried through truthfully.
Complete and well-proportioned form supplies the initial endowment that later conduct can affirm or belie.
Uprightness supplies the initial directional and normative orientation.
Returning something to a place supplies the reversal away from the initial configuration.
A lower location supplies the opposed endpoint of the reversal.
Lowness of rank adds a social and evaluative descent to the spatial movement.

structural_cues: The creation statement and the return statement form an opposed best-to-lowest sequence.
The sequential particle before the return marks a consequential turn while leaving its cause unstated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies upright formation, reversal, lowness, false action, and failed performance; I infer that a life can falsify its endowment through its trajectory. A passive decline or imposed reversal remains a live alternative and limits the claim of moral agency.

changed_reading.before: Denial is merely saying that future judgment is untrue.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be self-falsification: what makes a human life contradict its upright measure and fail the charge whose truth is tested at reckoning?

context_deltas.mechanism: Trusted assent is followed by intentional work, fitting repair, wage, negation, and non-depletion. This chain activates dīn simultaneously as debt and recompense, while the denial root's performance branch makes repudiation a failure to honor an already-operative account.

activation_trace.role: A charge proving false when not carried through supplies default by failed performance.
Reckoning and recompense supply settlement of the performed account.
Debt and credit supply the outstanding obligation whose settlement can be honored or repudiated.
Heart-settling credit supplies trusted assent at the opening of the performance chain.
Purposeful action converts credited assent into performed work.
Fitness for a thing supplies the criterion by which the work qualifies as account-worthy.
Payment for work supplies the return owed to performed action.
Exclusion and negation reverse the depletion condition attached to the reward.
Cutting and diminution supply the termination explicitly excluded from the wage.

structural_cues: An exception from the preceding descent contains a belief-action qualification followed by a consequence assigned to its people.
The reward is immediately modified by a negated depletion term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies credit, intentional work, fitness, wage, negation, cutting, debt, and recompense; I infer a covenantal ledger linking them. Reward may instead be sheer gift rather than earned settlement, so the commercial mechanism does not exhaust the line.

changed_reading.before: Reckoning is a remote verdict imposed after life.
changed_reading.after: Reckoning is the settlement of an account already opened by trust and performed action: what makes one default on a due whose wage structure is already visible?

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root can image an expected milk yield that disappears, and afterness can image returns separated by intervals. Reward explicitly protected from cutting reverses that failure pattern, so denial becomes the expectation that accountable return will peter out.

activation_trace.role: A milk supply that fails to continue supplies the image of a promised return disappointing expectation.
Recurrence after intervals supplies the temporal stress under which continuity is tested.
Recompense supplies the return whose durability is at issue.
Wage or recompense identifies the promised return.
Negation excludes the following cutting image from the reward.
Cutting and gradual diminution specify precisely the failure of duration that is denied.

structural_cues: The reward phrase places negation directly before a modifier whose inventory begins with cutting and depletion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed duration, interval, reward, negation, and cutting; I infer that the context answers a fear of return failing over time. The milk image is idiomatic and form-distant, so ordinary verbal denial remains the safer grammatical reading.

changed_reading.before: To deny dīn is to reject that recompense exists.
changed_reading.after: To deny dīn can include expecting recompense to behave like a yield that runs dry; the preceding promise activates a return specifically immune to depletion.

context_deltas.mechanism: A second negative interrogative names the worshipped authority and repeats the judge root in a superlative construction. It answers the focus question by placing denial inside a hearing whose judge combines adjudication with right knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Declaring false supplies the contested claim brought into the closing judicial question.
Judgment and recompense supply the matter over which the closing authority rules.
A frozen negative verb supplies the polarity of the rhetorical question that closes alternatives.
The worshipped one supplies the personal authority to whom the judgment belongs.
Judging between people turns dīn's account into an explicit adjudicative scene.
Right-reaching wisdom supplies the competence of the judge who settles the contested account.

structural_cues: Two adjacent interrogatives move from asking what produces denial to asking whether the named authority is unsurpassed in judgment.
The closing superlative repeats the judge root in both head and comparison term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel questions, negation, a named worshipped authority, reckoning, judgment, and right knowledge; I infer that the second question answers the first by locating the competent judge. Dīn may still retain obedience and religion alongside the judicial sense.

changed_reading.before: The focus question leaves the authority and forum of dīn unstated.
changed_reading.after: The focus becomes a courtroom challenge immediately answered by the identity and competence of the judge: what can sustain denial when the account belongs to the unsurpassed adjudicator?

context_deltas.mechanism: Return into lowness is followed by rectifying action, a recompense branch that mends a crooked break, and judgment that restrains or turns back for correction. Together they activate dīn as restorative accounting, not only punitive verdict.

activation_trace.role: Denial supplies resistance to the possibility that judgment can rectify rather than merely condemn.
Reckoning and recompense provide the process re-read as restorative settlement.
Return to a place supplies the reversible movement on which restoration can act.
Descent to a lower place supplies the damaged condition requiring correction.
Soundness opposed to corruption supplies the target state of restoration.
Mending a crooked fracture turns recompense into an image of repairing what descent has broken.
Restraint and turning back for correction supply the judge's reparative operation.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from downward return, through an exception defined by fitting action, to a closing judge question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reversal, lowness, soundness, fracture-mending, corrective restraint, and recompense; I supply the arrow that judgment repairs the broken trajectory. Wage and punitive adjudication remain live alternatives to this restorative model.

changed_reading.before: Dīn is a terminal sentence imposed on a fallen human.
changed_reading.after: Dīn can be the discerning settlement that exposes descent, recognizes rectification, and mends the crooked break: what makes such restorative accountability seem false?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses the focus root's deceptive-cloth branch with the non-dominant mapped inventory of the return root, where covering is stripped away. It remains anchored in the focus verb's false appearance and in dīn as reckoning, but downstream prose should present it only as an exposure metaphor, not as a claim that the return verb lexically means stripping here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus denial root includes an appearance that deceives like patterned cloth, while dīn supplies the reckoning at which appearance is tested.

activation_trace.role: A patterned surface that deceives by its condition supplies the possibility that an attractive exterior can belie what it covers.
Reckoning supplies the disclosure event at which surface and reality are compared.
Complete and balanced outward form supplies the potentially impressive surface under examination.
The split root's stripping of what clothes a thing supplies the exposure operation.
Being stripped of good until hardened supplies the darker possibility revealed beneath the surface.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns a spoken falsehood about judgment.
changed_reading.after: The focus can ask what will expose the best-looking human surface as a deceptive covering once the account strips appearance from actual moral substance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is strange because it activates the focus root's image of a wild animal running, stopping, and looking back, then joins it to stages, repeated return, and downward direction. It remains anchored in the focus verb and temporal construction, but should be rendered as a kinetic analogy for faltering, never as the verb's primary contextual sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus denial root has an interrupted-run branch, and temporal afterness can mark the stage at which the course stalls.

activation_trace.role: Running a stage and then stopping to look behind supplies a vivid shape for faltering after partial progress.
Afterness marks the completed stage after which the backward glance occurs.
Reckoning supplies the destination toward which the interrupted course should continue.
Successive phases divide the course into stages, making interruption after one stage legible.
Repetition, back-and-forth movement, and hesitation reinforce the stalled or reversing course.
Directed movement downward gives the interrupted course a consequential vector.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a static intellectual position.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be pictured as a course that runs one stage, falters, looks back, and turns downward instead of continuing toward its accountable destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it combines a formula of incumbency with obedience, protective governance, and the judge root's bridle image. It is still anchored in two focus roots and in the final governing root, but downstream prose should keep it as a restraint-and-guidance metaphor and should not collapse dīn into coercion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus denial root can urge an incumbent act, while dīn can name obedience and submission.

activation_trace.role: The urging formula supplies an obligation pressing upon the addressee.
Obedience and submission supply the governed response to that obligation.
Care, preservation, and governance supply a protective rather than merely coercive function.
The bridle image supplies restraint that directs movement and prevents destructive deviation.

changed_reading.before: The question asks only why a proposition is disbelieved.
changed_reading.after: The question can ask what makes the well-formed human resist an incumbent, preserving guidance that directs freedom toward accountable order.

strongest_changes: Measured, perceptible, upright embodiment gives afterness a concrete evidentiary antecedent and turns denial of reckoning into a challenge against displayed formative capacity.
The best-to-lowest reversal activates denial as enacted self-falsification: a trajectory can belie its own endowment and fail to carry its charge through.
Trust, purposeful work, fitness, wage, negation, and non-depletion activate dīn as a live account whose due is performed and settled, not merely a remote doctrine.
The closing judge question strengthens the forensic reading, while repair and corrective-restraint branches preserve a coexisting restorative rather than solely punitive judgment.
summary.what_was_special: The three focus roots behave as a switchyard rather than a single gloss: the denial root alternates among declaring false, being discredited, failing a charge, and failing expected duration; afterness alternates among sequence, threshold, and interval; dīn alternates among obedience, reckoning, debt, civic authority, and judicial credit. Context activates several coherent crossings without forcing them into one verdict.
remaining_uncertainties: The denial verb can foreground either the addressee as denier or the addressee as one being discredited; the surrounding questions strengthen both directions without fully eliminating either.
The debt, civic-order, yield, and restorative mechanisms may be analogical activations rather than direct contextual senses of dīn.
The descent may encode enacted moral failure, passive decline, imposed reversal, or more than one of these, so agency in the self-falsification model remains qualified.
The stripping, interrupted-course, and bridle readings are deliberately retained as branch-backed outliers and should remain visibly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Denial after staged evidence is an epistemic failure, not lack of data.** Lexical evidence: ك ذ ب B002, declaring someone or something false; ب ع د B002, afterness; د ي ن B002, reckoning/recompense. Structural cue: بعد follows a full sequence of oath signs, creation, fall, exception, and reward. Assigned role: بعد marks the lateness of denial; الدين names the reckoning/recompense now evidenced by the packet's own sequence. Abductive move: I infer that the question asks what active force remains capable of falsifying after evidence has accumulated. Reading change: the ayah reads as a diagnostic question about denial's mechanism, not simply a rebuke.

2. **Dīn as the whole obedience-debt-judgment order.** Lexical evidence: د ي ن B001, obedience/submission; د ي ن B002, reckoning/recompense; د ي ن B003, debt/credit; د ي ن B006, city of ordered authority; ء ج ر B001 in 95:6, recompense. Structural cue: the immediately preceding ayah joins عمل and أجر, while 95:8 names the judge. Assigned role: الدين gathers worshipful submission, debt/account, and ordered authority into one system. Abductive move: I infer that the packet activates multiple dīn branches simultaneously because the local context supplies work, recompense, city, and judge. Reading change: "the dīn" reads as an integrated order of obedience and requital, not only "religion" in isolation.

3. **After-distance can be depth of judgment or ruinous remoteness.** Lexical evidence: ب ع د B001, remoteness; ب ع د B004, being far off as ruin/curse; ب ع د B008, depth of judgment; ب ع د B009, no benefit/worth. Structural cue: بعد sits between the denial verb and الدين. Assigned role: "after" is temporal on the surface, but the branch inventory permits distance from nearness, ruinous exclusion, or far-reaching judgment. Abductive move: I infer that denial after evidence creates not only chronological lateness but moral distance from the secure/merciful frame. Reading change: the ayah can ask what sends you far away from judgment's obviousness after all this.

4. **The denier fails to carry through the charge.** Lexical evidence: ك ذ ب B004, whether a charge proves true by being carried through or fails; ك ذ ب B005, not delaying to act; ق و م B003, resolve/rising to undertake; ع م ل B001, intentional action. Structural cue: belief/work in 95:6 is followed by denial in 95:7. Assigned role: denial is not just a false statement; it is a failed charge or failed enactment when measured against the work that would prove assent. Abductive move: I infer that speech-act and action are tested together: a claim is true only if carried through. Reading change: "what makes you deny" can mean what makes your charge/action fail after the evidence.

5. **A hidden wild-animal hesitation image.** Lexical evidence: ك ذ ب B007, wild animal runs then stops to look behind; ط و ر B006, wildness beyond domestic limit; ء ن س B003/B004, familiar human-facing side. Structural cue: the surah moves from human formation to return/denial; this reading is exploratory because the branch is narrow. Assigned role: the denier behaves like a creature that cannot remain in the human-facing, familiar order and keeps stopping/looking back. Abductive move: I infer an affective posture from the lexical image of halted wild flight. Reading change: denial becomes a recoil into wild hesitation after the human was made present and upright.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 95:8 immediately answered 95:7, so the retrospective surprise is internal to the two-ayah closure: denial is not met by more evidence but by the identity and competence of the judge. Looking back to 95:1-6, بعد became heavier than temporal "after"; it now means after fruits/provision, places, secure trust, measured creation, fall, exception, and reward. The question exposes denial as a remaining force after the packet has exhausted material, spatial, anthropological, and legal evidence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A demand for the cause of post-evidence falsification.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ك ذ ب/B002` supplies declaring a person or report false, denying, or disproving it; fixed `ب ع د/B002` supplies temporal afterness. **Structural cue:** interrogative *mā* and initial *fa-* place the question after measured creation, downward return, exception, work, and enduring recompense (95:4–6). **Assigned role:** *baʿdu* turns the preceding sequence into an evidentiary threshold, while *mā* asks for the counter-cause that could still produce falsification. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies order but does not state that earlier claims compel assent; I infer evidence → expected confirmation, making denial causally anomalous. **Reading change:** the question is not a bare rebuke; it asks what mechanism could overturn the cumulative case “after” all this.

2. **A coexisting credibility trial.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ك ذ ب/B002` explicitly includes attributing falsehood to a person as well as to a report. **Structural cue:** the surface form carries the second-person object suffix *-ka*, and the next ayah introduces Allah and the judges. **Assigned role:** the addressee can occupy the position of the one being declared false, with *al-dīn* naming the matter on which credibility is tested. **Abductive move:** the packet does not identify an accuser; I infer a forensic alternative in which the question asks what could discredit “you” regarding the reckoning before the final judge is named. **Reading change:** without cancelling induced-denial syntax, the ayah can stage a trial of the addressee’s truthfulness rather than only describe the addressee’s act of denial.

3. **Falsification by failing to carry the charge through.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ك ذ ب/B004` supplies an attack or undertaking that “lies” when it fails and proves true when carried through. Earlier `ق و م/B003` supplies rising with resolve to undertake a matter, while 95:6 supplies intentional work and sound action. **Structural cue:** the question follows the contrast between endowed formation, downward reversal, and those whose action matches assent. **Assigned role:** the charge image turns truth into performed completion; failure to enact the endowed capacity makes the claim “human in best setting” fail in practice. **Abductive move:** the packet does not call life a charge; I infer endowment → undertaking → enacted verification or failure from the creation/work contrast. **Reading change:** *yukadhdhibuka* can concern practical non-fulfilment, not speech alone.

4. **The *dīn* as reckoning and recompense.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `د ي ن/B002` supplies judgment, accounting, recompense, and requital for deeds. **Structural cue:** *ajr* for work immediately precedes the question, and repeated `ح ك م/B002` adjudication immediately follows it in 95:8. **Assigned role:** *dīn* names the accounting operation that connects performed deeds to assigned return; the final judge guarantees its execution. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies the work/reward and judge endpoints; I infer that *dīn* is their mediating reckoning. **Reading change:** “the *dīn*” becomes specifically the reality of accountable requital, while a broader religious-way reading remains available.

5. **The *dīn* as an outstanding account.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `د ي ن/B003` supplies debt, credit, borrowing, and deferred sale. It is activated by `ع م ل/B004` wage, `ء ج ر/B001` contract-like recompense, and the temporal force of fixed `ب ع د/B002`. **Structural cue:** labor and its promised return precede a question about what comes afterward, before adjudication closes the sequence. **Assigned role:** debt supplies deferred obligation, *after* supplies maturity, and judgment supplies settlement. **Abductive move:** the packet does not posit a literal financial ledger; I infer deed/benefit → outstanding due → later settlement as an economic analogy. **Reading change:** *dīn* can be heard as a due account whose postponement does not make it unreal.

6. **The *dīn* as ordered obedience inside a jurisdiction.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `د ي ن/B001` supplies obedience, worship, and the way or law followed; fixed `د ي ن/B006` supplies a city understood as organized authority and obedience. The focus window includes the bounded trustworthy city (95:3) and the supreme adjudicator (95:8). **Structural cue:** civic place, believing/action-bearing subjects, *dīn*, and judge occur in one compact progression. **Assigned role:** the city supplies jurisdiction, *dīn* the lived order, and the judge its authoritative determination. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies these social roles but not their constitution; I infer bounded community → norm-governed conduct → adjudication. **Reading change:** *al-dīn* reads simultaneously as a practiced order of submission and the law under which conduct is judged, not only as a future event.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 95:8 was the sole later ayah and the decisive surprise. Its doubled `ح ك م/B002` strongly selected reckoning/recompense in fixed `د ي ن/B002`, while `ح ك م/B003` made the preceding falsification question forensic: whether the issue is induced denial or an attempt to discredit the addressee, a truth-reaching judge now controls the outcome.

baseline.text: Öyleyse bundan sonra seni hesaplaşmayı yalanlamaya iten nedir?

findings.text: Bundan sonra ifadesi, önceki yeminleri, yaratılışı, düşüşü ve ödülü birikmiş deliller hâline getirir; soru artık bilgi yokluğunu değil, bunca delile rağmen inkârı doğuran nedeni araştırır.
Soru, aynı zamanda “hesap konusunda seni kim yalancı çıkarabilir?” biçiminde bir güvenilirlik sınamasına da açılır.
Yalanlama, yalnız sözle reddetmek değil, üstlenilen işi sonuna kadar götüremeyip iddiayı davranışta boşa çıkarmaktır.
Hesaplaşma, yerine getirilen davranışların karşılığını bekleyen, vadesi gelince kapatılacak bir borç hesabı niteliği de taşır.
Hesaplaşma, güvenli bir topluluk içinde itaat edilen düzeni, yasayı ve bu düzenin yetkisini de kapsar.
Hesap düzeni, kişinin kendini üstün görmesini kırıp onu sonuçlarına boyun eğdiren bir kuvvet taşır.
Bundan sonra sözü, zamansal sonralığın yanında hakikatten uzaklaşma ve yıkıcı dışlanma mesafesi de kurar.
Bundan sonra sözü, hükmün ne kadar derine işlediğini ve inkârın artık yarar sağlamadığını da düşündürür.
Koşup durarak arkasına bakan yabani hayvan görüntüsü, inkârı delillerden sonra insan düzeninden geriye sıçrayan kararsızlık gibi tasvir eder.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Deliberate labor enters relations of wage, debt, valuation, restitution, livelihood, and release.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person is held under coercive ownership, then either restored through return or released without a counterpayment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: subjugation and enslavement `د ي ن:B004/m01`, release without ransom `م ن ن:B004/m01`, recovery and return `ر د د:B004/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Subjugation establishes control over the person, recovery reverses possession, and gratuitous release ends captivity without equivalent exchange. channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An inward character is oriented into worship, obedience, and straight conduct.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Character supplies the inward formation, religion gives it an order of obedience, and worship directs it toward the divine. Straightness is the shared state in which inner disposition and enacted allegiance coincide.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Inner disposition aligns with worship, belief, upright conduct, benefaction, and the possibility of religious return or rupture.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Religious straightness supplies the initial alignment, while apostatic return gives reversal a specific social and doctrinal form. The same root that returns a thing to a prior state can therefore mark a departure from the adopted religious order.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A place becomes intelligible through prominent terrain, named stations, residence, and the civic order maintained there.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The named landscape extends from mountains and towns into lunar stations, the noonday balance of the sun, civic obedience, and habitual residence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Residence, City, and Civic Obedience
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: People remain in a settled place whose identity depends on residence, assembly, and obedience to authority.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Residence converts land into an inhabited station, prolonged remaining stabilizes it, and civic obedience gives the settlement an ordered political form. City is therefore both a place occupied and a relation maintained.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Entities are located by edges, near and far relations, facing and trailing sides, and movement across a lower or outer boundary.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human beings form provisioned groups structured by possession, labor, rank, kinship, protection, and intimate attachment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rank, Aptitude, and Counsel
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Social position is evaluated through low rank, practical aptitude, penetrating counsel, and failure of judgment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: low social rank `س ف ل:B002/m01`, dullness and lagging capacity `ب ل د:B007/m01`, penetrating counsel `ب ع د:B008/m01`, weak opinion `ل ي س:B007/m01`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A woman returns to her family, and kinship organizes protection, jealousy, guarded closure, and their dishonorable absence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Companion, Confidant, and Inner Self
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Estrangement is removed by trusted company until the companion becomes an intimate, confidant, or figure for one's own self.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: companionship that removes estrangement `ء ن س:B003/m01`, intimate or chosen companion `ء ن س:B006/m01`, the self named as deceptive `ك ذ ب:B008/m01`, trust and security `ء م ن:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Companionship first removes isolation, then narrows into the chosen intimate. The lexical self introduces an inward participant whose truthfulness is not guaranteed, so trust becomes the relation that holds intimacy together.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Capacity appears as the ability to approach without fear, fit an intended role, bear a load, and continue rather than lag or stop.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human familiarity, technical suitability, warrior courage, animal stamina, bodily stature, and material strength become variations of remaining fit for engagement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Suitability and Immediate Readiness
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A participant is predisposed to a task, fits its requirements, reaches the limit of effort, and acts without delay.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: predisposition and worthiness `خ ل ق:B005/m01`, functional suitability `ص ل ح:B003/m01`, utmost effort `ح س ن:B005/m01`, effortful exertion `ع م ل:B007/m01`, action without delay `ك ذ ب:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Predisposition supplies latent capacity, suitability aligns that capacity with a particular use, and exertion realizes it at the limit of effort. Immediacy marks completed readiness by eliminating hesitation between fitness and action.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Small utterance forms organize discourse by pointing, questioning, urging, excluding, negating, calling, and answering.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Oiling, Perfuming, and Recurrent Application
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Oil or fragrance is spread over a surface and renewed through repeated application.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: oiling and anointing `ز ي ت:B003/m01`, aromatic coating `خ ل ق:B010/m01`, intermittent recurrence `ب ع د:B007/m01`, trodden path `ع م ل:B011/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Oiling and perfuming share the action of laying a substance onto a surface. Intermittent recurrence renews the coating, while the trodden path extends repeated application into a surface marked and maintained by passage.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A visible surface can display form, mark, polish, defect, decay, or ornament while concealing a different functional state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human beauty reaches into pupil reflections, an intact but blind eye, facial marks, worn cloth, deceptive ornament, polished ground contact, and sealed smoothness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Worn Cloth and Deceptive Ornament
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Cloth loses pile and integrity through wear, yet coloring or ornament can make its visible state misrepresent its actual condition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: frayed and worn cloth `خ ل ق:B009/m01`, ornamented cloth that belies its state `ك ذ ب:B009/m01`, material frailty `م ن ن:B002/m02`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Udder Filling and Milk Cessation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Milk gathers in the udder, is expected to continue, and then may disappear before that expectation is fulfilled.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: udder filling `ر د د:B007/m01`, milk that fails to last `ك ذ ب:B006/m01`, dependable animal `ء م ن:B001/m03`, exhaustion and cessation `م ن ن:B001/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Udder filling establishes stored abundance, dependability frames the expectation of continued yield, and failed duration breaks that expectation. Cessation turns a bodily production scene into a concrete model of reliability and disappointment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Animal life is organized through trained labor, bodily continuity, milk production, movement, and the protection of young.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human-centered roots disclose the trained work animal, the filling udder, milk that fails to last, an ostrich nest, young camels, and a wild animal that runs then stops to look back.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Run, Halt, and Backward Look
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A wild animal runs a stretch, stops, and looks back before motion resumes or ends.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: wild-animal run followed by a stop `ك ذ ب:B007/m01`, intermittent recurrence `ب ع د:B007/m01`, returning gaze `ر د د:B001/m03`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The run supplies forward motion, the stop breaks its continuity, and the returning gaze reverses orientation toward the path already crossed. Intermittence captures the repeated alternation between advance and pause.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Afterward, Interval, and Immediate Action
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: One event follows another, may recur after an interval, or occurs with no delay at all.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: subsequent time `ب ع د:B002/m01`, intermittent recurrence `ب ع د:B007/m01`, immediate enactment `ك ذ ب:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: `After` establishes ordinary succession, the intermittent construction inserts a gap before recurrence, and immediacy removes that gap. The three motifs define a compact scale from immediate action to delayed return.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Processes unfold through ordered stages, return in intervals, or terminate when their duration, material, or force is cut.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Temporal order spans stages of creation, hesitation, intermittent meetings, action without delay, repeated oiling, exhausted travel, failing milk, and fraying cloth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Uncut Continuity and Material Cessation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Duration persists when uncut, but exhaustion, failed yield, or wear severs an ongoing process.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: cutting or uninterrupted extension `م ن ن:B001/m01`, exhaustion that ends travel `م ن ن:B001/m02`, milk that does not persist `ك ذ ب:B006/m01`, cloth worn away through use `خ ل ق:B009/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Uncut extension names continuity positively through the absence of severance. Exhaustion, vanishing milk, and worn cloth provide three concrete ways in which motion, yield, and material presence reach an end.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Combat and the Truth of a Charge
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Combatants resist one another with weapons, and a charge is judged by whether the attacker carries it through or falters.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sword or staff combat `ب ل د:B011/m01`, resistance in combat `ق و م:B014/m01`, far-reaching hostility `ب ع د:B010/m01`, committed charge `ك ذ ب:B004/m01`, faltering charge `ك ذ ب:B004/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Hostility carries opposition into the encounter, armed combat gives it an instrument, and resistance holds the opponents against one another. identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin doğrudan gösterdiği varlık kent veya büyük yerleşimdir. word_morpheme_spans.note: word_analysis critical words are orthographic/analytic units, not QAC words; each resolves to a MORPHEME SPAN. The upstream aligned_qac_word_ref is preserved verbatim in word_analysis and is NOT corrected here -- renumbering would fabricate identities (PRINCIPLES.md §11 / basmalah no-hidden-renumbering rule). Use word_morpheme_spans for any word-level join to QAC.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: aligned_qac_word_ref does NOT resolve against qac_morphemes for this ayah: word-analysis counts orthographic words where QAC counts morphological words. Word-level joins between word_analysis topics and QAC morphology are UNRELIABLE here. Upstream defect in quran-data's word-analysis; deliberately not auto-repaired (renumbering would fabricate identities).

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.
